Roberta, a priestess of the church, is designated as the head priestess of a remote region in the northern edge—Dithmar. As the appointment came immediately after the disappearance of her predecessor, Roberta remained on guard and began to investigate Duke Ulrich of Dithmarschen. According to rumors, he has ruled over the region's lord for over 300 years, and even claimed to be an immortal... one who lives a life no human should be capable of possessing. Determined to uncover the truth, Roberta decides to trace his steps.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Lee Woon-Il, the founding chairman of Unjung Co., Ltd., which consolidated casino, liquor, construction, and lending businesses under one umbrella, and his successor, Chairman Lee Ju-Hwa. The sudden deaths of father and son, departing at the same hour on the same day, ignite a fierce power struggle within Unjung. Nam Dae-Gyun, the company's chief executive who confronts the power struggle head-on, and Kim Do-Jin, who finds himself unwittingly drawn into the conflict at a friend's request. This is their story.

(Source: Naver, translated)

In the barbaric age, those who knew honor were called knights.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Infant formula lids, yogurt spoons... Hunsung Tech, a small-to-medium enterprise specializing in small plastic products. Peek inside, and you'll find a family (?) business where the CEO, his son, brother-in-law, younger brother, and daughter-in-law each hold a position, squeezing the life out of other employees.

Within this Hunsung Tech, Manager Lee Gyeong-Min, working in administration, is the company's ace. His sharp work ethic, early morning arrivals, and late nights are standard. He covers for the incompetence of upper management and even looks out for the treatment of production workers. After years of struggling like this, his patience reached its limit. Then, something astonishing happened in Lee Gyeong-Min's life. 

Escape from the black company, job change, success, and even marriage. 99% of South Korea is made up of small and medium-sized enterprises! The fierce success story of one young man unfolding within one such SME.

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: At the End of the Night, I Met You
description:
Princess Laetitia of the Kingdom of Ranstein loses a bet with her club members and receives a penalty: she must dance with a man who is not handsome at the victory celebration banquet. Just then, she discovers a man standing alone with messy hair in a corner of the banquet hall. Listening to the chatter around her, she hears his name is 'Les Kisir', that he wasn't honorable on the battlefield, and that his family and birth are also lowly. Thinking he would be perfect for the penalty, Laetitia asked him to dance, but was unexpectedly rejected. However, it was only after seeing him limp away shortly after that she realized the reason... 

Embarrassed, Laetitia hastily followed him out, found Les, and offered her apologies. At the same time, she seduced him and spent a night together, but after that, there was no contact from him. Ultimately, she starts pursuing him actively, but Les doesn't seem to yield easily...

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/end_of_night), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/end_of_night)

display_title: A Maid's Peaceful Life Behind Hidden Power
description:
The Hero Andert.

A great swordsman who ended the Great War by sacrificing himself.
One of the rare heroes…

But he was actually a woman disguised as her dead younger brother.

That was me.

But…

“Huh?”

Did I just come back to life four years after my death? All I had was my body, so there was only one way to survive.

Becoming a maid.

“You’ve never worked as a maid before this, so what have you been doing all this time?”

“Jobless.”

“What motivated you to apply for this job?”

“Money.”

“What kind of mansion would you like to work in?”

“A mansion that is so hard to work in and so nasty that we don’t even know if it’ll be cleaned if we both work and die.”

“What kind of employer do you want?”

“A vicious employer that terrorizes their employees.”

That way I won’t get laid off since I’m the only one you can work with.

“…” The interviewer looked at me like I was crazy.

—

Here, I will start anew. Not as the Hero Andert or my deceased little brother.

But as the maid Daisy.

**Original Webtoon:**    
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/68910610), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%ED%9E%98%EC%9D%84-%EC%88%A8%EA%B8%B0%EA%B3%A0-%EC%A6%90%EA%B8%B0%EB%8A%94-%ED%8F%89%ED%99%94%EB%A1%9C%EC%9A%B4-%ED%95%98%EB%85%80-%EC%83%9D%ED%99%9C/4820)

*I can't do anything for him... Why is he being so nice to me?

“Dan-U, did you hate hanging out with me?”*

Heo Dan-U, a maxed-out survivalist and timid nerd, is being obsessively pursued by the dazzlingly popular prince Ji Ha-Jun. Ji Ha-Jun cooks, does laundry, and cleans just to spend time with Heo Dan-Woo... Something's fishy, right?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

display_title: The Obscene Secrets of That Duke's Slave
description: *Note: Part of Daiwon's Neungyonk BL Danpyeon (능욕BL단편) Collection.*

A human hero famed for slaying demons rescues a woman on the battlefield, only to awaken in the demon realm mid–wedding to her. She is a high-ranking demon seeking peace through a binding alliance, while he harbors deep hatred toward her kind. Bound by a pact that lasts until an heir is conceived, their forced marriage becomes a clash of prejudice, duty, and uneasy desire. 

Can enemies turned spouses find peace before war ignites again?

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/840075885)

My mother’s desperate hands, the finish line and the medal I longed for. Hyun-Yeo’s love is never reciprocated. In a life filled with unrequited love, the one person she could rely on was Han Yo-Jun. When even he inevitably became the object of her desperate unrequited love, she could no longer bear it. Whether it’s reciprocated or rejected, she’s done with unrequited love once and for all. 

(Source: Naver, translated)

After 12 years of horrible nightmares that prevent him from getting sleep, Ujin Kim dies and wakes up to find himself in the world from his nightmares! Surrounded by demons of all kinds, he quickly realizes that he’s been reincarnated into the body of a mercenary and heads out to find civilization. He quickly learns that this is a world filled with magic, a Church fighting the demons, and all sorts of sketchy characters. But hey, at least he’s finally able to get some sleep!

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Don't Look for the Resurrected Villainess
description:
God, I only asked for mercy—why resurrect me?

 *“Any final words?”

“...God, have mercy.”*

I was betrayed by those I trusted and ultimately beheaded. But with the divine decree, the world turned upside down. 

 *Evil runs rampant; I send you the resurrected. Stand firm against them.*

God. I asked you to have mercy on them, not to resurrect me. Can't you just let them perish?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

A strange catastrophe has struck the world, turning people into slimes. Min-Ha secretly takes her sister, who has turned into a slime, and sets out on a journey. Their destination is the one place her sister had always longed to visit. Along the way, as she encounters people who still hold memories of her sister, Min-Ha begins to confront the unfamiliar truths about the sister she once loved.

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: Is it Okay for a Murderer to be an Idol?
description:
Lee Yu-Min began his career with an unwavering determination to succeed. While practicing for an important year-end awards ceremony, he witnesses his leader, Han Se-Gye, committing murder. Although he blackmails him into keeping it a secret for the sake of the group, Se-Gye showers him with even more aggressive physical affection than before, leaving Yu-Min both flustered and deeply confused...

 *“I must be losing my mind… Why is my heart racing for a murderer?!”*

A ruthless killer or the affectionate leader and older brother of the team— which of these is Se-Gye’s true self?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Thirty-year-old unemployed man Lee Tae-Gyu. From some point onward, he's been living a lifeless existence, unable to feel the full range of emotions. Struggling to escape his meaningless routine, he encounters a mysterious old man who grants him the ability to copy others emotions through a will-o'-the-wisp. While testing this power, he becomes entangled with drama writer Kwak In-Ho. This encounter sends Tae-Gyu's life spiraling in an unexpected direction. Thus, he finds himself standing at the threshold of a new path: becoming an actor.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Ji-Yun, who had always been second in her class, suddenly found herself in possession of a “lucky notebook.” While the notebook granted her the good fortune of becoming first in her class, it also completely disrupted her peaceful daily life. To focus on her studies, she must solve the strange problems it presents. Amidst all the chaos, love blossoms—even though it’s a romance Ji-Yun never asked for...!

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: I Alone Have an EX-Rank Summon
description:
Summoned creatures have ranks, from the lowest F-rank to the highest S-rank... but something’s strange.

*“Why is my summon EX-rank?”*

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: The Eldest Daughter and Her Path to Success
description:
To parents who had wanted a son, their eldest daughter was neither useful nor lovable. Born as the eldest daughter of the Tilord family, Ladis was always forced to make sacrifices. But after striving until her very body was broken, what she received in return was ultimately her family’s betrayal.

 *“It was all a futile dream. I shouldn’t have lived for my parents, for my siblings, for my family, or for the family name. I should have lived for myself!”*

In that final moment she thought was the end, Ladis was transported back to the age of sixteen.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Harvey scrapes by working part-time at a fast-food joint. His only escape from this grueling life? Watching band performances! Then one day, through some incident, he gets tangled up with Logan, the vocalist of his idol band *Vanilla Sunday*...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

display_title: I Returned Thinking It Was the Ending, But The e Genre Had Changed
description:
Though I was the villainess in the original novel, I skillfully avoided death flags and faked my own demise to escape. I saved the poor child destined to die, sacrificed myself so the protagonists could live peaceful lives, and hid away, waiting for my own happy ending. My joy at finally hearing news of the original protagonists' wedding was short-lived. Upon receiving word of my mother's passing, I returned home... My childhood friend and fiancé, the original male lead, said:

*“If I knew you'd fall for a mere death notice, I would've done it sooner.”*

The man I thought had married another woman stared at me with deranged eyes and laughed. Why are you like this? You weren't this kind of person.

*“Now you can't go anywhere.”*

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: The Male Lead Is Trying To Tame Me With Money
description:
Reborn as the doomed heroine of a tragic novel, she is determined to avoid the male lead and live a quiet life. But when her family goes bankrupt, she’s forced to work as his aide.

Cold and demanding unlike his original self, he keeps her tied to him with money and even a contract engagement. Now trapped in the very story she tried to escape, all she wants is to break free.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/68857336), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EB%82%A8%EC%A3%BC%EA%B0%80-%EB%8F%88%EC%9C%BC%EB%A1%9C-%EB%82%98%EB%A5%BC-%EC%A1%B0%EB%A0%A8%ED%95%9C%EB%8B%A4/4817)

Lee Seo-Jun is a playboy whose hobby is changing partners every day. By chance, actor Yoon Ji-Han enters Seo-Jun’s life. Despite leaving each other with the worst first meeting and the worst first impression, Seo-Jun becomes intrigued by Ji-Han and starts hanging around him…

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

display_title: I Am the 5-Year-Old Spy Who Kidnapped the Villain
description:
I lost my parents in childhood, and died from overwork, all because of the rotten adults around me. Then, when I opened my eyes again, I had possessed a character inside a novel. 

Of all people, a spy belonging to a family notorious for its cruelty, an extra who dies before the protagonist even appears. The mission assigned to me: become the fake daughter of the novel’s main villain, Duke Crost. 

“I can’t die again just following other people’s orders.” But I know this novel’s story inside and out, so... 

“I’ll betray Duke Poz and side with Duke Crost!” 

“I’ll find Duke Crost’s lost family and stop him from ever becoming a villain.” 

“And I’ll ask him to find me an ally who can protect me from Duke Poz.” 

Of course, flipping the original story won’t be easy by any means. But in this life, no matter what it takes, I will find happiness!

**Original Webtoon:**   
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/68987766), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EC%95%85%EB%8B%B9%EC%9D%84-%EB%82%A9%EC%B9%98%ED%95%9C-5%EC%82%B4-%EC%8A%A4%ED%8C%8C%EC%9D%B4%EC%9E%85%EB%8B%88%EB%8B%A4/4829)

To become human, the nine-tailed fox Hyun-Su must fill 1,000 fox bowls with a woman’s affection. Just as he was about to fill the final bowl... Yi-Hwa, a woman from the Joseon Dynasty, died while clutching the bowl. Witnessing Yi-Hwa’s death, Hyun-Su feels betrayed by human love, and time continues to pass without her ever becoming human. 

In 2025, by chance, Hyun-Su becomes entangled with a woman named Baek Ha-Jin. After discovering that Ha-Jin, who resembles Yi-Hwa, is her reincarnation and is holding the bowl, he resolves that this time, he will definitely win Ha-jJn’s affection and become human.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Tae Jeong-Ha and Baek Ho-Su, who have been friends for over ten years, have been living together for a year, but Ho-Su tells Jeong-Ha, who seems to have no feelings for him, that he wants to break up. However, Ho-Su had forgotten that he and Jeong-Ha used to be a campus couple! From the day after they broke up, he feels uncomfortable seeing Jeong-Ha everywhere he goes on campus, but the more he tries to end their relationship, the more entangled they become. Will they ever be able to break up completely?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Lucella, who lost her only sibling, her sister, was now raising her sister’s son, Lucian, on her own. One day, she realizes that this world was actually inside a book, and Lucian was destined to become a villain in the future. Worse, he will be a terrible villain who torments the protagonist and gets brutally killed! 

“I can’t let my precious nephew die!” 

To keep her promise to her sister and to save the nephew she loves, she decides to raise Lucian to be a good person instead of a villain. But then… 

“Auntie, I want you to marry the Marquis.”  As if raising him properly wasn’t hard enough, now he’s saying weird things! 

“My uncle might not be the best husband material, but… at least he looks decent.”  Even the original story’s heroine was seriously trying to set up a matchmaking meeting. 

“I agree with that opinion.”  And her uncle just nods along like it makes sense. 

“Sorry, but I won’t think about marriage until I raise Lucian properly.” 

“So, you mean… as long as Lucian is raised well, it’s okay?” 

“Th-That’s not what I—” 

“I understand.” 

Why is everyone looking so excited?!

**Original Webtoon:**    
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/68742662), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EC%95%85%EB%8B%B9%EC%9D%84-%EB%B0%94%EB%A5%B4%EA%B2%8C-%ED%82%A4%EC%9B%8C%EB%B3%B4%EA%B2%A0%EC%8A%B5%EB%8B%88%EB%8B%A4/4790)

display_title: A K-Confucian Kid Saves the Villain Family
description:
I just woke up after getting sick from overeating one day.
But now, I've realized my past life as a righteous K-Kid (with a Taekwondo poom belt).

'And I have to save the world?!'

I can totally do that!

I'll start with the ill-mannered kids!

"It's not okay to talk so badly to your friends."

"What? Ha! What can a little pea like you do..."

I delivered a Hectopascal Kick, which I learned from Master Gyeonghye of the Taekwondo dojo.

"Aaargh!"

"Don't be so rude!"

That's right. The former K-Kid was strong (physically).
Very strong.

**Original Webtoon:**     
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/68635587), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/K-%EC%9C%A0%EA%B5%90-%EC%96%B4%EB%A6%B0%EC%9D%B4%EA%B0%80-%EC%95%85%EB%8B%B9-%EA%B0%80%EC%A1%B1%EC%9D%84-%EA%B5%AC%ED%95%A8/4794) 

**Official Translations:**    
[Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/202279)

Young yet old-fashioned Hojun becomes a team leader of a team of Gen Z employees. While he struggles to manage his picky and difficult team members, he ends up discovering their' secret pleasures... 

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

"I, Lee Myojin, was born to live for Assemblyman Tae Jeong-hwan’s household.” 

After Tae Jeong-hwan, Minister of Land and Infrastructure, disturbs a family burial ground, a terrible curse befalls the household. To protect the family’s eldest grandson, Tae Yu-gang, a young girl is raised in secret deep in the mountains at Sayundang—as a living talisman to absorb misfortune. 

“Whether you like it or not, I will pull you out of this hell.”

 Twenty-three years later, to the now-grown Yu-gang, she has become a cruel destiny— one he wants to keep by his side, even if he has to preserve her like a specimen.

[Original Novel](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=12412070) 

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=846363), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13589567)

display_title: The Villainess Is a Millionaire Fixer
description:
I’ve possessed the body of “Aristina Bianca Rosen,” the only daughter of the empire’s wealthiest tycoon and a woman of dazzling beauty. Just when I thought I’d be walking on a bed of roses… Of all times, I’ve been attacked by an unknown assailant right after being branded the empire’s worst villainess?! I narrowly escaped with my life, but the culprit is still out to get me. Thanks to my infamous past, there are suspects lurking everywhere… But the most dangerous of all are the three men circling around me. 

The Crown Prince, who’s kind on the surface but as cold as ice on the inside, the Second Prince, who growls and bickers with me every time we meet, and even the head of the Sacred Order, who’s far too prickly and secretive to be called a saint! I tried to run as far away as possible… so why are they all so obsessed with me?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

They embark on a pilgrimage to Antarctica to discover their true identity. Who are we, and where are we going?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Physical guiding is too disgusting for him, so he stubbornly insists on only doing radiant guiding. The problem child S-class guide Baek Su-Won. Having repeatedly knocked out the espers who attacked him, Su-Won now faces expulsion from the association... As a last chance, he's assigned to guide S-class esper Gong Ian on a business trip. But they say things go wrong from the start with someone incompatible. As luck would have it, Ian was the sexual harasser who rubbed himself against Su-Won on the bus. Somehow, Su-Won ends up bound by the worst possible contract: a month of ‘live-in guiding’.

But... This guy just gets more excited the more he gets hit... He's definitely not normal!

 *“Su-Won, you know what? I wanna die... for you♥”*

Can Su-Won really endure a month of physical guidance from Ian?!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
*Note: Part of Metatoon's Jungdok Danpyeonseon (중독 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: How to Tame My New Stepsister
description:
*"Were you always this lewd?"*

Sangyeo, who came to Seoul to study for college again began to live with his stepsister with his stepfather insisting. But he saw her in her underwear on the first day!!

*"It's been a while since we washed together, Sangyeo. Do you want to?"*

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Ah, the headstrong Charlotte Augusta? She really doesn’t seem like an Augusta at all. There’s a reason she still has no suitors even after three seasons in society.

Charlotte Augusta, the third of the five sisters from the renowned Augusta family in British high society. Charlotte, who was treated like a black sheep among her beautiful sisters, causes a major scandal at a ball she attended—as usual—in search of a husband. And there, she meets a handsome man with a refined charm. Prince Leopold of the Kingdom of Holland, a handsome man visible only to Charlotte’s eyes, agrees to clean up the mess she made and help her find England’s finest suitor—in exchange for her help in locating his own body, the whereabouts of which are unknown. 

*“Don’t worry, Lady. You won’t lose out on anything. As you help me, you’ll end up meeting every single one of England’s most eligible bachelors.”*

And so, as the two of them put their heads together every dawn when Leopold’s spirit awoke, the closer they got to their goal, the more confused they became by the feelings welling up toward each other…

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*"No matter how dark it gets, I can still recognize you. I know your scent, your breath, even the way you walk."*

My husband, this overly charming tyrant, is utterly deceitful in every way. Even if I've lost my memory, how can I be so wary of the husband I once loved? How can I feel so unfamiliar with him, so afraid? Eun-Sol didn't trust a single thing about him.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Sa-Ra, a high school senior who failed her exams, starts receiving tutoring from Seo-Won, her older brother's friend. Sa-ra becomes fascinated by Seo-Won, a student at a prestigious university with incredible social skills, but feels frustrated that he likely sees her as just a kid...

A high school senior's unrequited love story, filled with hesitation and anxiety as she struggles to approach the tutor she admires. 

(Source: Naver, translated)

Seung-Ju has had a long-standing crush on Jun-Hyuk, the student council president. One summer day, just as he was suffering from the pangs of unrequited love, the person who appeared before him was none other than Jun-Hyuk’s younger brother, Je-Hyun. Seung-Ju, who had a crush on his older brother, and Je-Hyun, who approached him. Will Seung-Ju ever be able to escape this agonizing unrequited love?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

After unexpectedly becoming the non-biological mother of her nephew Ji-Ho at a young age, Na-Eun builds a quiet life as a kindergarten teacher. But everything changes when Gang-u, the uncle of Minho, a child with selective mutism, offers her a high-paying live-in tutor job after discovering the boy only speaks around her. As they care for the children together, their unusual living arrangement slowly grows into something more than co-parenting.

(Source: WEBTOON

display_title: Sand Mage of the Burnt Desert
description:
*"My name is Zeon, and the entire desert is my weapon."*

Earth has been terraformed. As as side effect, the oceans evaporated, and the land turned into endless sand. Zeon is the only Sand Mage left on the desolated planet. The world calls him the Sand Wraith.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*“You know very well, Uncle, that I’m not a ‘scandal-maker’.”*

The ‘scandal-maker’ who took the blame for her cousin Bella’s crime, the ‘thief’ who coveted the duke’s property. All that remained for Harriet Listerwell was a tarnished reputation.

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: How I Ended Up as the Villainess’s Favorite
description:
I’ve been reincarnated as Lariette, a lowly sidekick destined to be the female lead’s errand girl. Tired of being a doormat, I decide to switch sides and suck up to the empire’s most powerful villainess, Evangeline. But the “vicious” villainess is actually a total sweetheart! Not only is she showering me with gifts, she’s now insisting I marry her brother so we can be family forever. There’s just one problem: her brother is the original male lead, a man supposed to be obsessed with the original heroine. I’ve tried my best to keep my distance, but he won’t stop pursuing me.

*“What makes you think I’m not interested in you, My Lady?”*

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Morán, a man whose only asset is his face! Just as he was dumped by his live-in lover and faced homelessness, he falls for Ho-Su's sweet talk when he appears claiming to like him.

 *“Hyung, you won't have to worry about money anymore.”*

Well, for a while, I guess I'll live in a nice place with this young, rich, cute boy. Morán thought it was nothing but a lighthearted idea, but he gradually became entangled with Ho-Su, who showered him with passionate attention and affection... 

This young boyfriend... something about him feels off...?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

display_title: I Am Really the Only Tycoon
description:
Lee Kyung-Suk, a mother who spent her entire life sacrificing herself for her family. She was the very embodiment of devotion, yet her son, Seo Min-Uk, never once said “thank you.” Living in regret after his mother’s passing, Min-Uk is transported back to the day the family tragedy began—as his maternal uncle, Lee Dong-Ho—through an unbelievable miracle. His maternal uncle, Lee Dong-Ho. He left after trampling on the family’s dreams and hopes, devouring the family’s entire fortune and bringing everything crashing down. Back in the past, Min-Uk resolves to set things right, but he is confronted by doubts that grow deeper by the day. 

*“If only our family could escape this rain falling upon the world, would that truly be enough to satisfy us?”*

Will his choice to save the past truly make his mother happy? A tale of sacrifice, regret, and redemption begins now!

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: For My Birthday, I Was Gifted Five Husbands
description:
Theodora Norton, my mother, lived her entire life in emotional suffering because of her husband. 

“I’ve prepared everything so you won’t have to live like me.” 

With her last breath, Theodora revealed that she had prepared not one, but several perfect men for my twenty-fourth birthday. I dismissed it as nothing more than the lingering resentment of a woman hurt by her husband’s infidelity until my father brought home a new wife, Agatha, and her daughter, Eplin, right after the funeral. Six years later, on my birthday, my father died. 

Just as I face losing my entire inheritance to Agatha and Eplin, five of the most powerful and sought-after men in the empire appear before me just as my mother had promised. 

Alfred, the eldest son of the southern admiral’s family. 

Percival, the Grand Duke of the North and a war hero. 

Kasius, a man with a suspiciously thriving business. 

Magnus, my former rival and now a renowned art patron. 

And Carter, my childhood friend, who knows everything about me and is now the High Priest. 

And so, I, Eugenie Norton, an ordinary graduate student, begin to rewrite the history of the empire with five extraordinary men as my husbands.

[Original Webtoon](https://ridibooks.com/books/845054460)

display_title: A Baby Cat Who Commands the Dog Clan
description:
The coming-of-age story of a kitten who finds herself in the middle of a dog clan!

Hong-Seol, a cat-human hybrid, was abandoned by her parents because she couldn’t use her inner energy. After a miserable death, she opens her eyes to find herself back at the moment just before she died.

 *"You are the child I’ve been searching for. Would you like to learn martial arts from me?"*

With nowhere else to go, Hong-Seol is approached by the formidable “dog” shu-in clan, the Grand Patriarch of the Namgung Clan, who extends a helping hand. To survive, Hong-Seol enters the Namgung Clan. 

 *“If they find out I’m a cat shu-in, I’ll be kicked out for sure!”* 

Whether they know of Hong-Seol’s daily struggle to walk on thin ice or not, these dogs come to visit her every day, wagging their tails. Except for one: the prickly eldest dog, Namgung Baek.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

After losing his parents as a child and becoming a slave to the Demon King's army, he is rescued by the hero "Uta." He then takes up his hammer and heads to the Street of Craftsmen, seeking what he truly desires. 

The story of the blacksmiths who helped him, not found in the hero's fairy tale, is told here. "Welcome to the Street of Craftsmen."

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=847612), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13655146)

She promises to keep it confidential and leaves— only to run into him again at a vacation spot she spent all her savings to visit. Then a headline suddenly breaks: 

[Chairman Joo Seok-jin to Marry This September] 

“What do you think about becoming my bride, Ms. Oh Ga-eun?” 

“Fine. But don’t you dare cut my salary or allowances.” 

And just like that, their contract marriage begins. 

Position: Fake wife 
Job: Daughter-in-law of a chaebol family 
Additional duty: Surviving the in-laws.

Mok Hwi-Young, a prominent merchant of the Central Plains, is killed in an attack by the Demon Sect one day. Just as he believes he has died, he finds himself transported back to his childhood—some thirty years earlier—when he was training as a lay disciple at the Wudang Sect. Then, a mysterious bamboo tablet appears before Hwi-Young, offering to buy and sell martial arts talents... 

What will Mok Hwi-Young be able to accomplish now that he has returned to the Wudang Sect?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Kim Ji-Su is a hotel housekeeper who can uncover guests’ secrets by reading the “stains of memory” left behind in their rooms. Using this ability, she runs a side business spying on guests’ private lives and blackmailing them. One day, while cleaning the room of a guest named Yeon-U, who had particularly caught her eye, she comes face to face with a memory she should never have seen.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Sa Hyun-Woo is an employee at the “Healing Agency,” where he exorcises possessed individuals by fighting evil spirits with his bare hands in exchange for payment. While carrying out a job, he discovers a group of villains who are deliberately implanting evil spirits to plunge the world into chaos. Enraged by their tyranny, which destroys precious relationships, Sa Hyun-Woo embarks on a life-or-death struggle to uproot the source of this evil.

(Source: Naver, translated)
*Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunjeong Danpyeonseon (순정 단편선) Collection.*

Live and die by your fists!

High school student Park Ki-Hyun is more confident in his fighting skills than anyone else. He assumed he’d naturally become the center of attention at his new school after transferring— 

 *“Huh? Knocking someone out in one hit was my specialty, wasn’t it…?”*

The result? Just one match! Facing an overwhelming opponent, Ki-Hyun’s pride is shattered, and driven by a single-minded determination to win, he eventually steps onto the mat— Hey, let’s have a match!!

(Source: Naver, translated)
*Note: Part of Haewadal Studio's Saegya Danpyeonseon (색야 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: The Youngest Member Filming a Parenting Show is Adorable

description:
The Central Realm, a unique world connected to countless other realms through numerous “gates.” Diz, an angel dispatched from Heaven on the Archangel's orders, is having a rough time at work. Then one day, a trouble-making demon named Pasang falls into Diz's life like a meteor!

A sweet & deadly, chaotic alliance featuring a selfish angel, a demon, and yet another troublemaker!

(Source: Naver, translated)

In a desolate world left only with extreme cold, a man named Chang-Jo lives alone, bravely and robustly thanks to his innate health. Chang-Jo works as a graveyard keeper in a village emptied by death, using knowledge gained from books to handle various tasks. One day, he discovers Yeon-Hwa collapsed in a snowfield. He picks him up and brings him home... 

 *“After peeling the chili, you fuse together.”*

Chang-Jo does his utmost to save Yeon-Hwa using the knowledge he learned from books (?).

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Archimond, the strongest necromancer who once plunged the continent into terror, had lost his life to the sword of the hero Berkel Reinland. And 200 years later, he was reborn as a baby of a certain sword clan and spoke his very first words:

*“Guardians of darkness, my servants, my soldiers—heed my command!”*

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: A Punk, Devoted to Pure Love
description:
Yu-Jin, the model student who dreamed of medical school, threw off her pace with a brief high school romance and blew her college entrance exams. While retaking them, her thug ex-boyfriend Jun-Ha reappears before her eyes. Is he trying to sabotage her exams again? Or is it genuine lingering affection?

A sexy campus romance between two people so different they can't help but be drawn to each other.

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: I’m the Only Guy at the Massage Shop
description:
*"Your touch... made me want to do it <3"*

He has the hands of god, but the life of the genius masseur, Hoyeon, suddenly hits rock bottom. With his back against the wall, the manager of the "Female Only VVIP Massage Shop" makes him an offer... His whole life drastically changes to one filled with thrill and excitement.

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

An old, shabby mage in his seventies returns to sixty years in the past to a much-awaited, deeply missed day from long ago…

(Source: Naver, translated)

Gung-Mak, a clown from a traveling troupe that roamed the eight provinces of Joseon. Just as he faced a tragic and unjust death, he was reborn as a modern K-pop idol. Was it fate's cruel joke? It seems the noblewoman Lee Sun he loved also reincarnated... But Gun-Mak is now a failing idol group on the verge of disbandment, while Lee Sun is the executive investor deciding the group's fate? Skipping the afterlife, the Joseon clown Gun-Mak reincarnates as Gen-Z idol Logan.

This is the story of his timeless love and his sweet potato-eating, cider-drinking escape from a failing idol group—a tale of growth.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*“Do you like me?”*

In eighth grade, Hwi-Min gets caught with a photo of his crush, Jung-Won, and ends up receiving unwanted attention. Whether it was luck or misfortune, the commotion quickly died down thanks to his already-existing status as a total outcast. Time passed indifferently, with no entanglement between the popular, cool Jung-Won and the nerdy, awkward Hwi-Min. After enough time passed for what once felt like a life-or-death situation to become a nostalgic black history, the now-adult Hwi-Min lives a peaceful, ordinary life as an unknown band member juggling multiple part-time jobs...

Until one day, he finds Jung-Won in an alley... or rather, he ends up picking him up?

 *“Can I stay at your place?”

“I'll pay you back with my body in exchange for a place to sleep.^^”*

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

display_title: Can I Give the Boss a Rating?
description:
Park Min-Hyuk, an ordinary office worker by day and a sweet dessert mukbang YouTuber by night. But at the end of every broadcast, his day always concluded with spicy kimchi stew. He ordered it again today without fail, but received a call saying delivery was impossible due to heavy snow—only for the kimchi stew restaurant owner to show up at his doorstep himself...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

At 18, Kwon Seung-Ho—the “Legend”—reigned supreme over high schools across Seoul, reaching the pinnacle of violence. But after reaching the top, Kwon Seung-Ho vanished without a trace... Now, ten years later, defying everyone’s expectations that he would have become at least a nationwide gang boss, he has reappeared as a new employee at Samjin Corporation!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Gwak Chang-Hyeok, the homeroom teacher with a poor reputation among students. Je Yil-Ro, who has a fetish for ‘dirty personalities and glasses,’ develops a peculiar interest in him. Then, Je Yil-Ro witnesses Gwak Chang-Hyeok talking to his girlfriend with an unusually gentle expression. That moment ignites a flame within Je Yil-Ro's twisted desires. After that, half out of curiosity and half for fun, he devises a plan to approach Gwak Chang-Hyeok...

When boiling a frog, you must use low heat. That way, the frog doesn't realize it's being boiled alive, and you can gobble it up in one bite.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Bottom of the 9th, two outs—the ‘Club Knight’ swings for the game-winning home run! An unknown power resides within the baseball bat. Dan's adventure to smash monsters from another world and return home!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
*Note: Part of Metatoon's Bulgongjeong Danpyeonseon (불공정 단편선) Collection.*

Lavis Vindica, son of the Great Demon King who rules the Demon Realm. He exterminated an entire demon clan that had defied him, earning the punishment of being banished to the human world. While living as an ordinary student, he discovers that his forbidden demonic energy reacts to ‘evil’. Gradually grasping how to wield this power, he sets out to find a way back to the demon realm.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Won Do-Yun, a boy left alone in the most run-down neighborhood. Though he had talent, the world dragged him down. In a world controlled by a massive cartel, he realizes that the higher he climbs, the deeper he sinks. Won Do-Yun ultimately makes a choice: the abyss over the summit. And he stands at the very center of the cartel, determined to bring the massive organization crashing down.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Soft and full, pudding-like touch... A 'sensational man' who became a masseuse only to touch a woman With a lot of young and solid Missy, you can fully fulfill your dreams in the new city of Westan!

*"I don't think you can touch a body like yours, selflessly."*

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

The hunter known as one of the Five Heroes, Choi Kang-Ho, lost his precious partner at the end of the Great War. Left behind after his partner's death was an egg. He held that egg close to his heart and vanished from the eyes of people... 

Exactly thirty years later, at 00:00 on January 1st, Seol-Ah was born from his partner's egg. And ominous signs reappear. To protect peace and raise Seol-Ah well, the absolute ruler of Cheorwon begins modern life.

(Source: Naver, translated)

On planet BA-506, where a wide variety of alien species have gathered to form a massive society, there exists a dream job that every living being on the planet longs for: the “Tower.”

Six months ago, Noah was abducted from Earth and brought there. Having lost all his memories, he ends up as merchandise on the black market, and is ordered to go to the Tower as a door-to-door salesman, tasked with satisfying various alien species.

[☆★Relieve your fatigue★☆]

A mysterious milk with astonishing effects, hidden beneath a provocative uniform. And so, Noah gradually climbs the floors, as aliens eagerly feed from him…

Song Hyunsoo, an unknown actor who makes a living as a bartender.
He gets cast in a famous director’s film and ends up acting alongside the nation’s famous actor, Yoon Juho.

He drinks only water that costs 400,000 won.
He replaces managers as casually as eating a meal.
—Yoon Juho, a man surrounded by countless rumors.

“Where do you live?”
“It’s okay. I can take the bus.”
“I asked where you live. I didn’t say I’d take you home.”
“…Bogwang-dong.”
“I will take you there.”

Though his words are mean, Hyunsoo becomes curious about the unexpectedly gentle side hidden in his past,
and a strange tension begins to form between the two.

“I fail to live up to expectations, leave people alone, hurt them… and every moment I’m reminded that I’m a defective product who only looks fine on the outside. When it comes to relationships, those are the only memories I have.”

But it doesn’t seem easy to conquer a prince who has lived his entire life as a top star…

The past he never even properly began to face fades away, and a new love approaches.
Change and growth to create a final love—and the final choice.

After completing his residency, Seol-Won opened an ophthalmology clinic in his hometown of Seosan. While visiting home, he decided to spend the holiday at a mountain villa with old friends from his hometown. However, his friends had to postpone their visit to the villa until the next day, leaving Seol-Won to spend the night alone at the villa. What woke Seol-Won from his sleep was the sound of an unfamiliar intruder. Filled with fear, Seol-Won tried contacting his friends and the police, but...

 *"I'm really sorry. We can't get the car in right now."

"Caller! Due to heavy snowfall, access to the mountain is currently difficult!"*

...He was isolated. And that too, alone with the unfamiliar intruder, Alpha Gu-Ju.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

The filthy, vulgar den of crime: the Ant Hill. I was born and raised here—a pure-blood ant. 
Though in the end, I'm nothing more than an ordinary worker ant. 

Ants aren't allowed to escape. And maybe it was the price for dreaming of freedom... Instead of an ID, the only thing that came back was my friend, reduced to ashes in the incinerator. 

Just when I had resigned myself to everything, Jang Heejo, the true master of the Ant Hill, appeared before me. 

"So... do you want to make me yours?"

"My first time will be with the person I love."

Love? First time? Way too romantic to come from the mouth of a man who causes bloodshed every single day. 

"Even if it isn't love, I'm fine with that."

"We'll see..."

The tables turned in an instant. 

**Original Webtoon:**

R15: [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/6067000002)

I went on a blind date as a stand-in for my older sister… only to find out the man was my supervising professor at the university hospital. Jeong Dasom agreed to take her sister’s place on a blind date for a small allowance of 300,000 won. But her date turned out to be a professor in the Emergency Medicine Department at SJ University Hospital—the very place where she was about to start her residency! He was infamous in the ER for being cold and ruthless, and if he found out she was just a substitute, her hospital life would be over before it even began. “Since we’re both at a perfectly suitable age for marriage, I’d like us to seriously consider seeing each other. What do you think?” …Wait. Was that basically a proposal just now? No, that’s not the problem. Should I confess right now—“I’m not your actual blind date, I’m just a stand-in!”? Or should I just quietly run away? Just as her mind went into full panic mode, an emergency call came in, and the man rushed back to the hospital. Not long after, the two met again—this time as professor and resident. Will Dasom be able to keep the truth about the substitute blind date hidden until the end? A clumsy, soft-hearted resident, Jeong Dasom, tangled up in a fake blind date, and a so-called cold-blooded emergency medicine professor, Tae Kang-hyuk—who, for some reason, is gentle only with her. A heart-racing medical romance set in the emergency room!

Eun Seo-U, once a promising shooting star in his school days, had to give up his athletic career after suffering an eye injury in a traffic accident and ended up working as a police officer in his hometown. One day, amid a string of trivial complaints and reports, he hears the sound of a shower running in a house where no one should be... Mistaking the sound for a burglar, he swings a frying pan—only to hit his ex-boyfriend, Yeon Ha-Neul, who is standing there naked?! Unlike Seo-U, who had pushed him away out of guilt over the accident, Ha-Neul approaches him again as if nothing had happened.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Claisy, who must marry in order to inherit her fortune, repeatedly misses opportunities to date due to the meddling of her niece Meron, who is only a few years younger than her. However, she eventually meets a man as if by fate and marries him after finding true love. During their happy honeymoon, a jealous Meron turns back time and returns to the past, and in this new life, she even goes so far as to steal Claisy’s husband. Having always been manipulated by Meron, Claisy declares that if Meron steals her husband, she will steal Meron’s husband in return! 

After their return to the past, Meron and Claisy end up swapping husbands. A bitter love quadrangle begins as the two men’s affections intertwine amidst the sharp psychological battle between the aunt and niece who know each other all too well.

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: The Rebel of the Tyrant Noble Family
description:
Ash had devoted himself to his adoptive father to repay the debt of gratitude he owed for being taken in as an orphan. But the truth he learned on his deathbed was quite different. All his hard work, the trust he had built, and even his innate, most powerful ability—the “Seven Wings”—had been stolen from him...! ...Well then, let’s begin the reversal of his life.

(Source: SORAJIMA, translated)

display_title: A Crazy Elf Gets a Dragon
description:
Born with a limitation that prevents his mana from growing any further, the elf Lifrill storms into a dragon’s lair in search of reawakening—only to fall straight into the clutches of the middle-aged dragon Alberion Hawey.
In his desperate attempt to obtain a single sip of dragon’s blood for his reawakening, Lifrill endures all kinds of exploitation at Alberion’s hands. And at the very end of it, with the dragon’s blood he barely manages to obtain, he finally attempts his reawakening…
A chaotic, explosive romantic comedy about the half-elf wanderer Lifrill and the middle-aged dragon Alberion Hawey!

(Source: RIDI, translated)

display_title: All I Need Is the Duke's Child
description:
*“If I could go back in time, I wouldn’t have fallen in love with him.”*

After returning to the past, her second marriage to her ex-husband was solely for the sake of her child. Unlike her previous life, where she had yearned for love, this second life—gained as if by a miracle— led her to choose marriage to him with the single-minded determination to reunite with her child.

 *“Just keep up the pretense of our marriage for exactly one year.”*

The price she paid was to cooperate with him in uncovering the secret behind the incident from ten years ago, just as he wished. She thought they were just a couple in name only, bound by that contract… 

 *“We don’t necessarily have to spend our wedding night together—”

“I want to.”*

He was different from her past life.

(Source: Naver, translated)

I died in an unexpected accident, only to wake up possessed by a doctor. Fifteen years as a medical drama fanatic. They say even a dog at a Confucian school can recite poetry after three years, so I learned quite a bit of medical jargon—but a doctor? Really?! To make matters worse, I ended up becoming the personal physician to Jin, the leader of a massive rebel army and a terminally ill patient. But what's with these doctors around here? Pouring boiling oil on wounds? Draining the raw blood from patients who are coughing up blood?!

 *“Everyone entering this room must wash their hands thoroughly from now on!”

“The new doctor sure has a lot of rules. Interesting.”*

Three months remain until Jin's predicted death. Can this quack doctor actually save him?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Ordinary married woman by day, magical girl by night? Taegon is indifferent to his perfect wife, ‘Sora’. Anyone would see her as an ideal woman, but because he loves the magical girl ‘Pink Lumina’, he neglects her. However, one day, he discovers Lumina’s true identity...

*“My wife… is a magical girl?!”*

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

display_title: I Was Possessed in an Extremely Private Area
description:
Entertainment reporter Lee Ju-Won died in a traffic accident. When he opened his eyes again, he found himself possessed by Jung Yeon-U, the chaebol heir and entertainment company director. Before he could even process the situation, the doorbell rang. Standing at the door was... national heartthrob actor Seo Hui-Jae?! Without hesitation, Hui-Jae entered the room and approached Yeon-U, kissing him roughly.

Could I possibly be... Seo Hui-Jae's sex partner?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

display_title: My Story on My Stepsister’s Secret Account
description:
After his mother remarries, Minseong ends up living with his stepsister, Sohyun. One day, by accident, he sees her naked. But something feels strangely familiar—the moles on her chest look exactly like those of a woman who appears on a secret, explicit account his friend once showed him. He tries to brush it off as a coincidence. Then a new post goes up on that account. \[LewdRabbit – Today, my stepbrother came into my room without knocking… and I ended up showing him my body.\]

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

"The reason I am leaving this letter—though you may already know—is to keep a promise."

Elisha, the Archmage of the Cardion Empire and fiancée of Emperor Erich.

"Your Highness, no, you know what His Majesty the Emperor always used to say.
'I will never marry you, not even if I die!'"

One day, she suddenly vanished, leaving only a single letter behind for her fiancé.
However, contrary to Elisha's expectation that he would not look for her, Erich immediately began searching for her...

"Whether she is within the Empire or has left the country. I just have to find her and bring her back."

If he finds her and brings her before his eyes, then...

"We must make a new promise."

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/3776003633)

display_title: There Are No Bad Military Dogs
description:
Min Ah-Hyeon, who grew up abused as a test subject in a research facility, enlists in the military, which seems connected to the facility, to uncover its secrets. There, she meets her direct superior, Shin Hae-Jun. He was a military dog who unquestioningly obeyed orders from above, no matter how contradictory. The world reaches its end with the emergence of zombies. Amid the chaos, Ah-Hyeon loses her younger brother and blames Hae-Jun for it. To avoid ever crossing paths with him again, she deserts and becomes a mercenary. But Hae-Jun calmly tracks her down, offering to help find her brother and proposing they work together...!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

The late crime boss’s final command: 

“Protect my daughter!” 

Jason, a clumsy hitman flown in from Mexico, begins an unexpected childcare mission in Suyu-dong, Seoul. But the three-year-old girl turns out to be far more terrifying than her father ever was. From chaotic tantrums to outrageous antics, Jason’s new life becomes a nonstop disaster of survival parenting. And when she starts daycare, he realizes the chaos has only just begun.

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=847842), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13740307)

Ferdi is a writer renowned across the continent for his erotic novels.
However, surprisingly, this sensational author
is Vivian, a quiet woman working as a night librarian at the Imperial Library.

While every new release has been a hit and garnered enthusiastic love from readers,
her fourth work is facing a barrage of harsh criticism for its sexual descriptions being too dry, unlike her previous works. The problem is not merely her writing skill.

Vivian was bound by a long-standing covenant to remain a virgin, and consequently, she had been writing without any direct personal experience.
Outwardly elegant and calm,
her life had been one where she had to suppress even her own desires.

Then, one day, while she was working the night shift at the library, Aiden—the Emperor's older brother and the ruthless prince of the court—visits her, and her daily life begins to shake.
Aiden is known as a cold and distant figure.
However, in front of Vivian, he is strangely affectionate and
begins to take an interest in her secret.
And he says,

“I can break that contract for you.”

[Original Webtoon](https://ridibooks.com/books/3885043751)

Kwon Taejung, the youngest son of Taesung Group and a dominant alpha known for causing trouble, is sent to the redevelopment zone “Daram-dong” after sparking controversy with a road rage incident. His assignment is to complete the demolition quietly within three months and clear out the remaining residents.

The biggest obstacle in front of him is Yeon Leekyeom, the last resident of Daram-dong and an omega. Burdened by relocation fraud, his grandfather’s hospital bills, and private loan debt, Leekyeom lives a precarious life under constant threat from thugs. When the documentary team behind Nightmare of the Demolition Village attempts to cover Leekyeom’s story again, Taejung approaches him under false pretenses to prevent any report that could interfere with the project.

Leekyeom mistakes him for the new manager of a security team, and Taejung allows the misunderstanding to continue while offering calculated kindness for his own purposes. However, drawn in by Leekyeom’s faint scent, Taejung begins to take an interest he never planned on having.

Though he approached him with hidden motives, even those motives begin to fade. Yeon Leekyeom, who is sick and tired of Taejung, the “thug”, yet cannot help but crumble in front of the gentleness he shows, finds himself drawn closer day by day…

To Hae-Jin, the stranger with black eyes, ‘family’ was the warmth he wanted to protect with his entire life. But instead of the blessings of his 20th birthday, a cruel tragedy arrived. To save his shattered family, Hae-Jin offers himself as a commodity. His partner was Ryle, a cold-blooded tycoon and extreme alpha. To Ryle, Hae-Jin was merely a disposable commodity to relieve his pheromone congestion. Despite being a dominant alpha, Ryle despised omegas intensely. Hae-Jin was treated like a tool, his body and mind crumbling further amidst the humiliation and abuse from servants who ignored their master's neglect. As days piled up, each one barely bearable, news of his parents' death, his sole support arrived. Hae-Jin left behind the life of nothing but suffering in the mansion. It was only after that Hae-Jin departed that something strange began to happen to Ryle, who had thought of him as just another easily acquired omega.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

display_title: I'm a Fairy, Not a Saintess
description:
“Seon-nyeo. You resemble me, so you must help people.”

Before my mother’s teachings, I made the same vow every time.
That I would not live as a shaman like her.

The place I arrived at after dying while desperately avoiding the gods, was a Western romance fantasy world where such vows weren’t even necessary!

But then…

[Can you hear my voice? From now on, you are the Saintess we have appointed!]

No, why is the god here calling me Seong-nyeo(saintess) again?!

===

[Your late grandmother is wandering around that man.]
“My James, have you been doing well?”

“G-grandma…?!”

I flaunted a flashy wrist snap and shook the bell.

“The woman you’re trying to marry… Absolutely not!”

I’m someone who died after rejecting this kind of life in my previous life. So why am I doing this now?

And on top of that, when I went to meet the emperor as the god ordered, the killing intent he gave off was no joke.

“To call someone a Saintess straight out of some ancient legend. This isn’t child’s play.”

To stop the destruction of the world, I have to persuade this man?

Why does it have to be a religion hater of all people!

**Original Webtoon:**     
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/68491618), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EC%84%B1%EB%85%80%EA%B0%80-%EC%95%84%EB%8B%88%EB%9D%BC-%EC%84%A0%EB%85%80%EC%9D%B8%EB%8D%B0%EC%9A%94/4763)

A society where class is determined from birth, where the strong prey on the weak. Among them, Hwang Ji-Hwan, a rabbit classified as the lowest class and weakest, is treated like trash by society, scraping by through gambling and scams. One day, while pulling off a scam as usual, Ji-Hwan becomes entangled with the fox organization at the apex of this survival-of-the-fittest hierarchy and finds his life threatened.

 *“He's mine, so you guys can get lost.”*

At that moment, the fox Jang Wi-Ran, whom he had slept with by chance three years prior, appears and rescues Ji-Hwan... 

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

*“How about sleeping with me whenever I want? Sounds like it'd be fun.”*

By day, he's a capable assistant manager at a major corporation; by night, he's a famous gay streamer living a perfect double life. But his routine starts to crumble when a parachute hire joins the company.

 *“Manager, you seem to be living quite an interesting life.”

**[A 100-Night Challenge Between a Farmer and a Worm Asking to Share Yang Energy]**

The only occupants of a shabby, one-room thatched hut were the farmer Nongbu and a white dog. Nongbu made a living by renting land from a well-known local landlord, and after another long day of plowing his fields, he returned home and wrapped up his day.

*“Haah….”*

Exhausted from farm work, Nongbu fell into a deep sleep... But suddenly, a strange, moan-like sound echoed through the room. The odd thing was, he was the only person inside. Kicking off his worn blanket, the only one he owned, mended by the wife of his neighbor and only friend Gaecheol, the farmer twisted in distress.

*“Mm….”*

It was impossible to tell what was tormenting him. Soon, the ties of his thin undergarment came undone, exposing his bare skin. Tossing and turning across his bedding, the farmer broke out in a cold sweat, letting out soft moans again and again.

Just who is tormenting 22-year-old Hong Nongbu every night? To answer that, we must go back to the daytime, ninety-nine days earlier.

description:
After graduating from the academy, Lien was living a perfectly ordinary life when, one day, sudden news reached her.
Dian—the sole heir to the kingdom’s only dukedom and her childhood friend—had fallen ill with a mysterious disease.
In search of a way to cure him, an oracle is brought forth from the Temple of Healing, but it reads:
"For fifteen days, at every sunrise and sunset, he must partake of a maiden’s milk."
"Is that even possible? Can a maiden produce milk?"
"There is a magical potion; if she takes it, it becomes possible."
Wait, does that mean Dian has to... directly suckle from another woman's breast?
What is this? Why does my chest feel so tight?
"Are they looking for a volunteer—"
"I’ll do it. Um.. but.. you know. I don't have any experience."

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/2404037774)

Three hundred years have passed since the dragon and the serpent vanished. The Heavenly Emperor, who had worried about the human realm, commands the last dragon, Yeonmok, who had gone into seclusion after the death of his beloved disciple, to find the whereabouts of the dragon and the serpent. Descending to the human realm, Yeonmok encounters an enigmatic young serpent named Doya...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

display_title: The Chairman of Pharmaceutical Company Is a Poison King
description:
300 years in the future, Earth was enveloped in mana. I was a "Mana Reject," meaning mana is poisonous to me. One day, while I was awaiting my death without even awakening, I connected with another version of my soul from a different dimension— The Supreme Poison Demon Tang Gun-ak, the supreme master of the Jianghu.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: The Baby Villain Who Foretells the Future
description:
Bunny is a four-year-old orphan who thinks she has finally hit the jackpot when she is taken into a ducal household. But instead of a fairy-tale life, she finds herself in a place where survival is anything but easy. Luckily, Bunny has a mysterious “genius secret notebook” that gives her life-saving advice, helps her win powerful allies, and even reveals shocking future events. With her charm, wit, and uncanny guidance, Bunny slowly captures the hearts of the duke’s family. Yet behind her adorable face lies a far greater secret, one tied to a dark destiny she may not fully understand. As she grows, Bunny must rely on her notebook and her own cleverness to change her fate and become the remarkable person she is meant to be.

display_title: Apocalypse Villainess: Surviving With Corporate Slave Skills
description:
I was a corporate slave in my third year at the company when I woke up to find myself possessing Princess Sarah—a character from a novel who causes nothing but trouble with her annoying behavior and eventually meets a tragic death after being universally hated.

To make matters worse, this world is in an apocalyptic state overrun by zombies!

Sarah tries to survive using the experience and skills she developed as a hardworking office employee. But somehow, the Crown Prince and the Grand Duke—who were supposed to hate Sarah—begin obsessing over her instead. She even becomes someone everyone relies on… Total chaos!?

Can she overcome this desperate situation and escape from the apocalyptic world? And what will become of her romances with the heroes!?

In a world where guides have no human rights, the only being Shio must protect is his younger brother, Ter. Having struggled to escape the fate of being a ‘selected one’—little better than an Esper sex slave—Shio heads to the Esper house, a place akin to hell, when his brother becomes selected.

 *“Who left their guide behind?”*

But unluckily, Sio encounters Esper, Erutio, before his brother. Sio tries to escape him, but...

 *“Coming here smelling like this? You want me to eat you, don't you?”
“I, I came to find my brother...!”
“Then crawl nicely. Beg for your brother's life with your guiding.”*

The arrogant Erutio violates Shio without restraint, cruelly holding him captive. Time passes, and Shio grows accustomed to this life. Days flow by neither happy nor unhappy, but Erutio seems oddly off.

 *“Tell me about yourself.”*

Suddenly trying to have a conversation?

 *“I want to kiss you.”*

After starting with sex, now demanding a kiss? How on earth am I supposed to appease this utterly capricious Esper?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

*Note: Include three extra chapters.*

For 8 long years, I clung to a one-sided love, until I finally put an end to it.

He never once looked my way. Instead, I became the subject of whispered mockery and careless cruelty, wounds I carried in silence. Even so, I convinced myself that someday he would turn around and see me. Only now did I realize the truth. It wasn’t love. It was obsession.

So I made a decision. I would forget the Crown Prince. I would stop wounding myself over someone who never chose me and start seeking a happiness that belonged solely to me.

"This is the end. From now on, I’ll live for myself."

That was what I believed, until he appeared again, no longer the Crown Prince but the Emperor.

"What is my fiancée doing here?"

As though nothing had changed, he addressed me so naturally. The past I thought I had closed the door on stood before me once again, and the emotions I had carefully buried began to stir.

Why now? What does he want?

A woman determined to end her love, and a man who refuses to believe it ever ended.

Staring at the scars left behind by 8 years of unrequited devotion, I ask myself,

This time... can I truly let it go?

Yun Ju-Won, a job seeker about to graduate from college, ends up going on a hot spring trip at the urging of his twin friends Cha Cha-Hyeon and Cha Cha-Yun, whom he's known for ten years. But this trip feels strangely off. The pension they booked by chance is eerily quiet, and instead of taking the bath they were told to, the twins become fixated on Ju-Won's inverted nipples...

After being reborn, he gains the ability to read past memories, "psychometry." Using this ability, he begins to destroy corrupt politicians and businesspeople, as well as the enemies who drove him to his death.

On a rainy night, Yu-Seong wakes up alone amidst a pile of trash. Unable to remember who he is or where he came from, he begins a new life at Café NOAH. As Yu-Seong spends his days in a state of peaceful yet precarious existence, Kim U-Hyeon, the owner of a hardware store, appears before him. Observing Yu-Seong’s every move with a gaze that is seemingly indifferent yet piercing, U-Hyeon exudes a dangerous aura. Yu-Seong assumes their encounter is merely a passing connection, but when U-Hyeon rescues him from an attack, he makes an unexpected remark.

 *“We’ve met before, haven’t we? Don’t you remember?”

“Want to be friends?”*

Yu-Seong, indifferent to his own wounds, and U-Hyeon, who relentlessly probes that tremor. What will the two of them face at the end of this night?

display_title: The Mastermind I Killed Came Back to Life
description:
A dark mastermind desperate to die and a heroine who reluctantly grants his wish—an unpredictable, sweet romance!/

After possessing someone else's body, Luana dreams of a wealthy life and attempts to rob the dark mastermind Eden's vault. Caught off guard by unexpected circumstances, she accidentally shoots him. Eden, thought dead, surprisingly revives. Along with his new resurrection ability, he gains the power to see a status window detailing missions tied to the world's survival...

Turns out, a divine intervention was behind Eden's special abilities?! With the arrival of Raphi, the cat sidekick character who's a messenger of the gods, Luana and Eden embark on a chaotic, desperate struggle to save the world!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

A collection of high-intensity stories set across various sports settings, exploring the hidden desires and tangled relationships of those involved. From unexpected encounters to boundary-pushing situations, each episode delves into provocative and controversial dynamics, blending competition, temptation, and human instinct into a series of bold, adult-oriented narratives.

[Original Webtoon](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/sex_sports)

Facing death, the scenes of his life flashed before his eyes—and every single one was miserable and sordid. Park Dong-Sik, a thug working as a debt collector for loan shark Moon Ho-Cheol. With no mercy, compassion, or loyalty when it comes to overdue debts, Dong-Sik fulfills his duties admirably once again today. He’ll even go so far as to pull down his pants and urinate in someone else’s shop to collect money. His only hobby is watching porn featuring men in suits. Just as he’s getting fully aroused while enjoying the video alone in his car, a stranger suddenly approaches him. The man, hunched over, asks to borrow a light. This man, so beautiful and elegant that Dong-Sik has never even seen his like on TV, takes Dong-Sik’s lighter and walks away. As Dong-Sik watches him go, he witnesses the man, who had been standing uneasily at the end of the breakwater, suddenly jump into the sea. Without a moment’s hesitation, Dong-Sik jumps into the sea after him. But in the pitch-black darkness, the man is nowhere to be found. Just as Dong-Sik is about to surface in the pitch-black sea where he can see nothing, something begins to pull at his ankle...

During his time in an orphanage, after being abandoned by his parents and unable to endure the abuse, he had run away on his own. When he finally managed to reunite with his father, the joy of their reunion was short-lived; his father took all the money Dong-Sik had saved and disappeared again. Dong-Sik then ended up working under a loan shark, taking on all sorts of dangerous jobs and narrowly escaping death on numerous occasions. Dong-Sik’s last memory was a plea: “Please let me be born into a wealthy family in my next life, so I can live without a single worry.” When he opened his eyes again, he found himself in a top-tier private hospital room—neither heaven nor hell. And in the mirror stood not Park Dong-Sik, but the man Dong-Sik had been trying to save. As Dong-Sik stood bewildered by this utterly incomprehensible phenomenon, another man appeared, volunteering to be his guardian. The man, who suddenly kissed him while asking, “How could you forget me?” was calling Dong-Sik “sister-in-law.”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

display_title: The Archduke Woke Up in a Strange Place
description:
Why— 

“Aren’t you going to tell me I’m pretty today?” 

How did he go from a pure and reserved man to a bold, straightforward seducer?! 

“Pretend to be the young lady and maintain the engagement for just three months.” 

I got thrown into an R-rated reverse harem novel and possessed a side character, only to watch the female lead die right in front of me. To make matters worse, her family demanded that a commoner like me impersonate a noble lady. I was ready to refuse without a second thought, but— 

“Once the contract is completed, you’ll be paid five million Mint in full.” 

It was enough money to live comfortably for the rest of my life. My debt-ridden commoner’s body reacted faster than my mind. 

…

Deal!

 It was supposed to be just a small whim. I thought I’d help my pitiful fiancé open his eyes a little before I left. But why on earth— 

“Aren’t you going to tell me I’m pretty today?” 

The reserved, innocent man I knew had turned into a bold, straightforward seducer! 

“Your Highness, you’re not supposed to be like this!” 

“I’m trying to make you fall in love with me, Cynthia.” 

The violet eyes that had always been hidden beneath his eyelids now gleamed darkly. 

“So hurry up and fall for me, Cynthia.”

**Original Webtoon:**    
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/68991740), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EB%8C%80%EA%B3%B5%EB%8B%98%EC%9D%B4-%EC%9D%B4%EC%83%81%ED%95%9C-%EB%8D%B0%EC%97%90-%EB%88%88%EC%9D%84-%EB%96%B4%EC%8A%B5%EB%8B%88%EB%8B%A4/4824)

display_title: The Difficulties Faced by a Married Couple
description:
Long, long ago, deep within the towering forest, there existed a world inhabited only by humanoids. Among them, two adjacent mountains were home to the Fox Tribe and the Wolf Tribe, living separately. The beastmen from these two tribes fought constantly, like sworn enemies, and caught in the crossfire was the small village of herbivorous beastmen nestled between the mountains. 

*“Please stop fighting! If this keeps up, we'll all pack up and move away!!”*

Finally, the furious herbivore-type humanoids declared a strike, forcing the Fox Tribe and Wolf Tribe to prepare a wedding for peace. Thus, Hwang Mi-Ho of the Fox Tribe and Jang Woo-Rang of the Wolf Tribe were chosen as representatives of their tribes and bound in matrimony.

*“What?! You have no shame?! How could you...”

“What's so terrible about spending the first night together? Ah, could this be your first time?”*

They intended to create harmony through marriage, but will this truly lead to a happy ending... for everyone?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

In a land long ravaged by war, Minju grows up hearing tales that on certain nights, the spirits of the dead roam and take the living. After discovering that her guardians plan to sell her as a human sacrifice to a river god, she flees into the mountains. Lost in the darkness, she is saved by a mysterious being known as Baekgwi- a white-haired spirit clad in armor. 

Baekgwi offers her a grim bargain: if she can find his missing corpse within ten days, he will spare her life. If she fails, he will kill her. As Minju struggles against time to uncover the truth hidden in the mountain, she begins to question the true nature of Baekgwi - whether he is truly a ghost, and what binds him to the world of the living.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

A carriage more luxurious than I’ve ever seen, a mansion so big I couldn’t tell if it was a home or a castle. My seven-year-old life, spent cozily with my father in a rural village, changed forever when the immensely wealthy Count Travel finally tracked down his runaway second son.

My dad is a noble? I have a rich grandfather?!

My relatives didn’t give my father a warm welcome after his six-years absence; instead, they pierced him with cold, hostile glares. n that moment, strange scenes began to surface my mind like a torrential rainstorm.

Berry, you must be careful of the relatives. Travel is a den of beasts, all hunting for the position of family head.

Lady Berry! News has arrived… Young Master Reitan has been killed in action!

Seven years old, ten years old, sixteen years old…
They were all me, yet they were memories I didn’t remember.
And in every single one of those memories, my father met a meaningless, tragic death.

***

This… this can’t possibly be real.

“Head Butler, did you recently purchase a large amount of stock in an ink company that’s about to go bankrupt?”
“That company would never go bust… Wait, how did you know I bought those stocks?”

Ack! That was exactly right, too!

If these memories are real, then this time, I will save my father no matter what.

But I can’t do this alone.
I need an ally who will be my greatest pillar of support.
Fortunately, there is a hidden gem that only I know of.
Someone who looks like a mud-covered pebble right now, so no one thinks to keep their guard up.

“Crown Prince Theon Phil Boltman.”

My first plan is to make that young boy my ally.

Peace shattered in an instant. Two people transformed into demons by the king’s summons. Can we really entrust the fate of Joseon to them...?

PD Kim Seongyun produces a show that introduces children to different professions by inviting people from various career fields. This time, he is looking to cast hoteliers and people who run hotels and resorts. Among his target list is Seo Hanhee, the CEO of SC Hotel & Resort, and Seongyun struggles to secure him.

“I have no intention of appearing on television.”  
“Could you at least give us one interview? We’ll come to you in person.”

After endless pleading, Seongyun finally manages to go interview the difficult Hanhee. At least, that is what Seongyun thought at the time. He had no idea Hanhee would end up clinging to him.

After the interview, Hanhee not only agrees to appear on the show but also starts contacting Seongyun on his own. Filming and editing wrap up smoothly, and Seongyun wants to cut off contact now that everything is done, but…

Why does this man keep calling me?
