Bound by duty and hierarchy, she endures a cold arrangement where her role is clear and her feelings irrelevant. Yet beneath the harsh commands and forbidden intimacy, unspoken emotions begin to stir, turning a cruel obligation into a complicated bond neither of them expected.

[Original Webtoon](https://ridibooks.com/books/3498026399)

“If you don’t believe me, why don’t you touch it yourself?”

That was the provocative joke Hee-young, Junhyeong’s female club friend, threw at him, a freshman with no dating experience.
What started as a teasingly suggestive conversation quickly turns into dangerous tension, and an irresistible attraction leads the two into an increasingly risky relationship.

They may look like innocent college students on the outside, but the moment the door closes, they crave each other more fiercely and passionately than anyone else.

[Original Webtoon](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000076886)

The Duke of Covington dies under mysterious circumstances, and with the arrival of her half-brother Lucius, Eloise, her sisters, and the Duchess lose everything overnight. Eloise sets out alone for Wayport to protect her family. But all that awaited her was a harsh reality and endless trials. At the depths of despair, she meets a man: the pirate Hawk. With his help, Eloise escapes the crisis and, concealing her identity and disguised as a man, infiltrates Hawk’s pirate ship. Drawing on the strategic skills honed as an heir apparent, Eloise resolves the ship’s problems. As Hawk grows attracted to her, he begins to feel confused by his own emotions. A relationship blossoms between the two on the free and dazzling sea. However, awaiting them at the end is a massive political struggle intertwined with the downfall of her family…

A romantic fantasy set on the sea where freedom, conspiracy, and love intertwine: \*My Pirate Prince\*

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Aunt Yunjung had always protected Sanghun since he was a child. Then one day, with the news of his aunt's marriage, he moved to Seoul. Time passed, and Sanghun became a university student. As he pondered where to spend his vacation, news of his aunt, whom he hadn't seen in a long time, reached him. Sanghun arrived at his aunt's house with excitement and anticipation. His aunt, who opened the door and came out, was wrapped in only a shower towel, looking at Sanghun and welcoming him happily...

**Original Webtoon:**    
[RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/3587013647), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13893465), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/aunts_embrace), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/comic/C000077011), [Toptoon](https://toptoon.com/comic/ep_list/my_aunts_arms?p_id=pp_1601_001), [Toomics](https://www.toomics.com/uplmscg/episode/toon/9157) 

**Official Translations:**   
[Japanese](https://www.toptoon.jp/product/129973)

In 2009, a time when the analog and digital worlds were intertwining and colliding. In Busan during that time lived an ordinary high school sophomore named Eo-Jin, whose true identity was Lee Jeong-Dok, a famous figure on the internet. She was a well-known fanfiction writer for “Armageddon,” one of the top idol groups of 2009. Lee Jeong-Dok had been active while hiding her true identity from everyone. However, her identity was discovered by none other than Nam Ju-Yeon, the younger brother of Armageddon member Ji-Hyeok...

Nam Ju-Yeon uses this as leverage to blackmail her. Will Eo-Jin be able to keep her secret safe amidst Nam Ju-Yeon’s blackmail...? 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: [Inter-Floor X-Sound Anthology] To My Detestable Younger Sibling]
description:
A “monster” has taken possession of the body of his deceased younger brother, Seo Ji-U, who was obsessed with him. The monster proposes that it will leave the body if he has sex with it four times. Do-Hyun is falling apart, torn between fear and hatred of his brother and this unknown entity, and a longing for his family...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Part of Lucent's Cheunggan X-eum Danpyeonseon (층간X음 단편선) Collection.*

Aiden is a die-hard fan of the unknown band Chasm. Just before a show, he witnesses the band’s leader walk out right before his eyes, leaving the group on the brink of breaking up.

*“Shit! How are we supposed to play without a bassist?”

“I, I’ll play bass!”*

He was thrust into the role of Chasm’s bassist on the spot, but Aiden’s playing skills were nothing short of disastrous... Seth, already on edge from a breakup and financial struggles, acts recklessly toward Aiden, and the fate of the two of them and the band hangs in the balance.

 *“Hey, if you can’t play that song all the way through by next week, I’ll bite off your lips and fingers. Got it?”*

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

display_title: Even if You Can't Eat, Go
description:
Jo Tae-san is a man who has lived his life with the sole determination to “protect his family,” driven by the memory of a father who ruined their home through gambling and violence.

His wife, Kang Jin-hee, is having an affair with a thug, even going so far as to film explicit videos with him. Then, his life takes a sudden turn when he is diagnosed with terminal stomach cancer.

Realizing he is facing death, he can no longer hold back. He begins to live his life completely differently, unleashing the anger, urges, and desires he has long suppressed.

[Original Webtoon](https://www.toomics.com/uplmscg/episode/toon/8957)

Seo Eun-woo, a college student who's lived the life of a nerd accustomed to eating in the bathroom. One day, Lee Yeon-joo, the campus's most beautiful goddess, starts flirting with him...?

*"Well, let's meet up. Then we'll definitely figure something out."*

The love story of a nerd and an enigmatic campus goddess. But...is love really this difficult and challenging?

(Source: Naver, translated)

*“So you've been sharing your bed with a demon, my lady. I never imagined my wife could be so vulgar.”*

Just because she had a dream about a demon, her husband, affectionate throughout their marriage, suddenly changed in an instant. Niv endured a life treated worse than an animal, like a candle that could be snuffed out at any moment. Then Delphion appeared, like salvation in that life. Niv fell helplessly for his mysterious, languid aura, continuing her illicit affair with the demon as her body and soul became drenched in desire...

 *“Do you call the one you love your savior?”*

Therefore, to survive, she had to grasp the savior's hand. Even if it was impure.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

After a long struggle, Jihoon, an ordinary 29-year-old man, finally lands a job at a liquor company. He dreams of a happy future with his girlfriend Yejin, who has faithfully stayed by his side for six years. However, beginning with Sohee, his team leader who possesses a mature charm completely opposite to Yejin’s, Jihoon becomes entangled with various women through alcohol… And little by little, his youth starts to spiral out of control.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Min-ah's father left her with nothing but debt before she even became an adult. As she worked as a golf course caddy, paying off the debt day by day, a group of old men appeared, claiming to be her father's old friends.

*"You're only 22, still so young, but already so commendable."

"Ah, mister, wait, just a moment."

"Ugh, wh-what are you doing...!!" "What do you think I'm doing?"

"I'm trying to get back the money your father never paid me, even if it's just this."*

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

display_title: In the Dungeon with a Childhood Friend
description: *Note: Part of Playtoon's Play Danpyeonseon (플래이 단편선) Collection.*

In the early hours of the morning, art student Su-Yeon”witnesses a secret involving her classmate Yu-Shin in the studio.

 *“You… were a robot?”*

Yu-Shin tries to shock Su-Yeon’s head with electricity but fails, and Su-Yeon faints on the spot. That night, Su-Yeon is dragged to Yu-Shin’s house. As her plans with her friend Jae-Hyun go awry, the fates of the three begin to slowly unravel…

A sweet and thrilling campus love triangle featuring young people whose paths keep crossing!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Seo-Hun, an unknown idol in his third year since debut. When illegal footage of his younger brother, Eloy, a successful idol in contrast to him, is leaked, Seo-Hun assaults another idol who insulted his brother during a live broadcast. Afterward, Eloy takes his own life, and Seo-Hun’s life also spirals into ruin.

*Heart-Pounding Island*, an extreme deserted island survival variety show featuring celebrities like Seo-Hun who have caused controversy and seen their lives plummet into ruin.

 *“The person who ruined Eloy’s life is there.”*

Drawn in by a call from a mysterious figure, Seo-Hun participates in the 10-day show to uncover the truth behind his brother’s death.

(Source: Naver, translated)
*Note: Part of Metatoon's Bimil Danpyeonseon (비밀(秘密) 단편선) Collection.*

Lewis, a masochist and passionate omega with cross-dressing tendencies, suffers from the trauma of being raped during his college days. Though he lost much—including being disowned by his family and suffering deep psychological wounds—from that rape, he lives on as a paid doctor, unbroken. Then one day, the bastard Camillo, the one who raped him and sent his once-promising life spiraling into ruin, is found injured, collapsed near his home?!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

*“Did you meet that bastard?”

“You mean that weakling parasite living off us? Did you meet him again?”*

Ju-Han, So-Eun’s first love and the executive director of Seohan, one of Korea’s leading corporations. Ju-Han has one secret he can’t tell anyone. He suffers from dissociative identity disorder, where his daytime personality differs from his nighttime one. So-Eun, who became the Seohan family's personal physician at the request of Tae-Geon, the Seohan chairman and someone like a brother to her late father, one day encounters Ju-Han's other personality. 

 *“Call me Ju-Han.”

“Just hold my hand. You don't have to do anything else, okay?”*

Unlike the sharp-eyed daytime Ju-Han, the nighttime Ju-Han burrows into So-Eun's embrace like a large dog, his eyes filled with longing. Despite being one person, So-Eun finds herself constantly swaying between daytime Ju-Han and nighttime Ju-Han... 

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Do-Hwa, who can see ghosts, becomes susceptible to possession starting on her 30th birthday. Coincidentally, he is possessed by a lustful ghost who happens to be a virgin. Wandering in his possessed state, he encounters Mu-Yeong and tries to attack him. However, Mu-Yeong, being a grim reaper, recognizes Do-Hwa's possessed state and helps the lustful ghost achieve enlightenment...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Dahlia had an ecstatic, once-in-a-lifetime experience on her wedding night. As she longed for that moment to happen again, her married life went on in a dull and painfully monotonous way, until she witnessed her husband’s infidelity. One night, while drunk, her husband slipped on the rooftop and died. At her husband’s funeral, Dahlia suddenly finds herself unjustly accused of murdering him. Then Sebastian, her husband’s identical twin brother, appears before her. Sebastian offers to help her avoid the royal guard’s infamous interrogation, on the condition that she bear his child. When she refuses, he reveals a shocking truth. “Dahlia, do you really believe the man who spent your wedding night with you was Calix?” The truth is, the one who shared that intoxicating wedding night with Dahlia was not her husband, but her brother-in-law.

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13758423), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/297088177), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/brotherinlawsproxy), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000076732), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=260147), [Mootoon](https://www.mootoon.co.kr/comic/moo_list.mg?tcode=avgm), [Qtoon](https://www.qtoon.co.kr/toon/list.mg?tcode=6azo), Toon365, ZzangComic, [Onestory](https://onestory.co.kr/detail/H049247365), [Nate](https://toonnbook.nate.com/detail/H049247365), [Aladin](https://www.aladin.co.kr/shop/wproduct.aspx?ItemId=388780826), [KyoboBook](https://ebook-product.kyobobook.co.kr/dig/epd/ebook/E000012653155), [Yes24](https://www.yes24.com/product/goods/183640135)

Seoul, a second-year medical student at Korea University, was relieving academic stress in a secretive way he couldn't tell anyone about—

 *“Huh, hmm... right here feels so good...”*

...masturbating his prostate while listening to sticky slime ASMR in his single dorm room. But when the dorm undergoes remodeling, he suddenly becomes roommates with Jin-Hu, a physical education major. His alone time vanishes, and Seoul's pent-up frustration reaches its limit....

 *“From now on, you're my dildo.”*

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=846782), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13634954)   

"My father was made into a devil."
Heo Ye-Ju, a top-tier hitman, has lived a hellish life for 30 years as the daughter of serial killer Heo Wook-Yeol. Although Heo Wook-Yeol's innocence is revealed today, they still live in hell, and Ye-Ju attempts to become a devil herself to save those living in hell with her...

display_title: [Mr. Blue BL Short Stories] Desire Development Team
description:
1-8. **Alpha Dog Gildeurigi** (알파독 길들이기) \[Gyogwan\]
9-18.**Marriage Blue** (메리지블루) \[Pachi\]
19-27. **Chojja Sagikkun, Gom Jabatda!** (초짜 사기꾼, 곰 잡았다!) \[Naepilmyeong\]
28-32. **Geojinmarui Jinghu** (거짓말의 징후) \[Mobingeo\]

Once a beloved star, actor Yujin’s world crumbles overnight after a casting couch scandal. Swept up in false rumors and left with nothing, Yujin eventually realizes acting is his only true calling.

During this low point, a chance encounter at a bar leads to a one-night stand. The man is none other than Taehoon, the managing director of the industry giant, SB Entertainment. Exploiting Yujin’s heat cycle, Taehoon offers a tempting deal: a sponsorship and a path back to stardom.

Desperate to return to the screen, Yujin eventually takes Taehoon’s hand. But life doesn’t improve as expected, and Taehoon’s obsession and control only tighten under the guise of their partnership. Then, Hail—a photographer who has long watched Yujin from afar—appears and begins to stir Yujin’s heart.

To reclaim his stage and his life, Yujin must face his hardest choice yet.    
In a world tangled with love and desire, what decision will he make?

[Original Webtoon](https://ridibooks.com/books/3097002075)

After drinking a single bottle of wine while intoxicated, Hyun-Jun finds himself entangled with Ki-Yeon, a vampire. Until he can break the contract, he is forced into an awkward living arrangement with Ki-Yeon… What will become of this story—of Ki-Yeon, the vampire searching for a true partner, and Hyun-Jun, the human who has become hopelessly ensnared in Ki-Yeon’s trap?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Part of Lucent's Cheunggan X-eum Danpyeonseon (층간X음 단편선) Collection.*

Jung Young-Hwan, an outcast who has become the school bullies’ plaything. He is tormented day in and day out, denied even the most basic human dignity. Yet what pains him most is not their violence, but his own weakness—his inability to stand up to them even once. Finally unable to endure the bullying any longer, Young-Hwan attempts to take his own life. And who saves him? None other than my counterpart from a parallel world? 

The Jung Young-hwan from the parallel world was completely different from the Young-Hwan in this world. He had a strong, unwavering attitude and exuded confidence.

 *“…You’re lucky. You don’t have to worry about how much you’ll get beaten today. We’re the same person… so why am I such a pathetic loser?”*

(Source: Naver, translated)

Ma Do-Ae was born with a curse that plunges the other person into misfortune the moment she loves or is loved. There is only one way to break this curse: finding a "fated partner" who is immune to it. But of all people, the only candidate turns out to be the delinquent Gong Seon-Hwa? Forced into a relationship with the worst kind of man just to end the curse, will Do-Ae finally be able to find the "real deal" this time?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=849913), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=14052414)

Joo Eunhye has spent her life in a strict, wealthy household where she’s always been forced to be “obedient.” She seems to be living an enviable life according to her family’s wishes, but just two years into her marriage, she witnesses her husband cheating. When she confronts him, Eunhye learns that this marriage wasn’t love—it was a “deal.” 

Afterward, at a bar she used to frequent, she meets the alluring bartender Lee Yuri. He gets by living off allowances from wealthy women he maintains secret relationships with, and on impulse, she proposes “a night” with him… 

“Are you really going to cheat with me? I’m expensive.”

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/yubunyeo_complex), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/MW_Complex)

*“Let's make a deal!”*

Ji-An, CEO of a perfume company, has lived her entire life focused solely on scent. After a car accident, she suffers inexplicable loss of smell, bringing her entire life to a halt. But then, she senses a fragrance only from a man she encounters by chance on the street. Han Do-Yun...?! To find the reason, Ji-An proposes a contract to him.

A fragrant romance that begins with a chance encounter!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Giwoo, living alone and working as a laborer on an apartment construction site, gradually becomes close to Han-gyeol, a college student who sometimes watches him intently. One day, during a drinking session with Han-gyeol, Giwoo learns that Han-gyeol is still a virgin who hasn’t even kissed anyone.

Without realizing it, Giwoo lies to make himself seem more experienced, and Han-gyeol teasingly begs him to teach him how to kiss…

“So, you’ve never dated anyone before?”  
“Um… yeah… I guess.”  
“Whoa, so you’re a virgin?”

[Original Novel](https://ridibooks.com/books/1632009539)  

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1632012441), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000078003)

"You have a knack for driving people crazy."

A marriage that began without love.
The distance that always existed between him and me.

"Hang in there. You've done well so far. Nothing will change."

The only person I wanted to lean on in this house was becoming a source of despair.

"...Let's get a divorce."

"I've liked Jeong-hu for a long time. Even before we got married."

He remained silent despite my belated confession. We
were living in the same space, but in different times.

The time difference between us had already grown. Could we bridge that gap?


**Original Novel**:   
R15: [Naver Series](https://m.series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=5569069), [Kakaopage](https://page.kakao.com/content/56507229)   
R19: [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/3302000560?_rdt_sid=author&_rdt_idx=5)

**Original Webtoon**:   
[R15](https://ridibooks.com/books/3093003705?_rdt_sid=author&_rdt_idx=7), [R19](https://ridibooks.com/books/3093003696?_s=instant&_q=%EA%B2%B0%ED%98%BC%EC%8B%9C%EC%B0%A8&_rdt_sid=search_instant&_rdt_idx=4&_rdt_arg=%EA%B2%B0%ED%98%BC%EC%8B%9C%EC%B0%A8)

Summer, who had only thoughts of revenge against the duke's house, fell for the enemy's youngest son! 

The day she lost her brother to the Valonek Duke's house, Summer's world completely collapsed. Her sole reason for surviving was to avenge the duke's family. Summer, who had sworn vengeance against the duke's family, heard rumors that the duke's youngest son, Gray Valonek, was seeking a personal aide. Disguised as the noble lady ‘Adel’, she arrived at the social club, Full Moon. But the moment she met his drunkenly languid blue eyes, Summer realized. She was slowly sinking into an emotional quagmire deeper than her vengeance...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: [Colorful Night Anthology] I Got Screwed by My Friends
description: *Note: Part of Haewadal Studio's Saegya Danpyeonseon (색야 단편선) Collection.*

Tae-Oh, who had secretly loved Hae-San since elementary school, worked tirelessly to raise his college entrance exam scores by two levels. He finally enrolled at the same university as Hae-San, determined to confess his feelings once he became a confident adult. At the freshman welcome party, Tae-Oh bumped into Hae-San as if by chance and impulsively confessed. The two began dating as if by accident. Now, Tae-Oh is utterly intoxicated with the joy of finally being able to do all the XX things he'd only ever imagined! But can he really subdue Hae-San, who claims his ideal type is someone devoted and pure, with all these XX acts?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

Yusu, the illegitimate son of the Jincheon Group chairman, decided to willingly accept the obsessive love of his father, brother, Cheongsu, and nephew, Yeonhu, in order to make them pay the price for trampling on his mother and him.

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/lainey_131), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/gwangya_symbio), [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/3075003305)
[Original Webtoon](https://ridibooks.com/books/5345000024)

Jun is the greatest scientist among the current spacefaring humanity. As a member of the 17th generation of spacefaring humanity who abandoned Earth to roam the cosmos, he succeeds in developing a vaccine for space sickness. The sole purpose of his research was to awaken Kendrick, a first-generation space human from the 1st century who had been cryogenically frozen after dedicating his life to eradicating space sickness... but as Jun conducted his research, he secretly developed feelings for him. After the vaccine was developed and Kendrick finally awoke, something seemed a little off?!

 *“Jun, I’ve been waiting for you.”*

A single sentence uttered by Kendrick, who had been cryogenically frozen 16 generations ago.

*“How does Kendrick know my name?”*

Even as He thought, “That can’t be possible…” her heart raced as Kendrick approached him without hesitation. Thus began a romance transcending time and space between the two of them.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Kim Seoyeon (Song Sammi), a swindler, is chased by gangsters after a marriage scam and coincidentally hides in a church. There, she encounters a seemingly chaotic yet harmonious pastor's family. However, this place turns out to be a cult church, and the pastor is exploiting not only his followers but also his own children. Blinded by the huge church funds, Seoyeon decides to pull another scam. To do so, she digs into the pastor's family's weaknesses to dismantle them, forming relationships with everyone. However, contrary to Seoyeon's intentions, the siblings find comfort in her, gradually rally around her, and begin to revere her as their savior (Messiah), starting to confront their father. Seoyeon's plan, which started with a lie, leads to an unintended revolution(?)...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Lee Chan left without a word, and Seo-Ho was left alone without even having time to ask why. Now that they’ve met again as adults, Seo-Ho finds himself torn once more. Seo-Ho tries to avoid bringing up the past, and Lee Chan, in the end, can’t bring himself to say anything. Even now that they’ve reunited, there are still so many things left unsaid between them.

 *“Seo-Ho, being left alone feels really lonely. Did you feel this way too?”*

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

After his mother’s death, Subin grows disgusted with his father, who quickly remarries a much younger woman. Living with his new stepmother, Eunjung, he develops complicated feelings for her. As he begins to see traces of his mother in Eunjung, his feelings grow into a desire to save her from his father…

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/between_the_doors), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/between_the_doors)

display_title: I Already Said Two Was Too Much
description:
Bomi is a popular social butterfly at school, known as a go-to advisor for dating and even nicknamed a “couple matching manager.” Ironically, she has never been in a relationship herself. She has long harbored a crush on her childhood friend’s older brother, Juheon, but he only sees her as a little sister. Meanwhile, her childhood friend Sihu constantly interferes with any guy who approaches her, claiming no one understands her better than he does. As tensions build, Bomi finally reaches her breaking point—and both brothers begin to reveal their hidden desires, turning their complicated relationship into something far more intense and unpredictable.

[Original Webtoon](https://ridibooks.com/books/4343003407)

A man who has never experienced the warmth of affection finds himself consumed by an obsession with a user named “Cocorose” in an anonymous group chat. To a man whose existence in a cramped gosiwon is already hanging by a thread, a single emoticon was enough to stroke his vanity, and a solitary delusion was enough to shatter his reality. The moment he misinterpreted an anonymous woman’s message as a sign of love, his bottom-tier youth began its descent into total catastrophe. Now, he is trapped in a collision between the woman from his daily life and the one from the digital shadows. It wasn’t truly love he was seeking, but a sense of salvation. This is the chronicle of a “trash-tier” romance, ignited by the desperate fantasies of a man with nothing left to lose.

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=843473), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13236266)

*“Have you heard of the mimic slug?”*

The protagonist, a researcher of mysterious creatures, receives a suspicious letter. It was a request to use the mimic slug, which can transform into the appearance of others, to make it seem as though his deceased daughter had come back to life. Arriving at the mansion with a sense of foreboding, the protagonist found the “young lady” waiting for him.

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: The Baby Villain Dreams of Conquering the World

description:
Dr. Yuju Seo wakes up in another person’s body after a fatal hit-and-run. To survive, she pretends to be the body’s original owner, claiming amnesia. Now she must live with a stranger she has to call her husband, and against her will, she begins to fall helplessly in love with him. But will he still love her when he discovers she isn’t his real wife?

(Source: WEBTOON)

A widow enters a forbidden marriage with her late husband’s devoted disciple. On their wedding night, grief and desire collide, and she finds herself drawn into a passion she knows she should resist. Haunted by a promise he once made as a boy, and torn between guilt and longing, she must face whether crossing this taboo is true love or an inescapable fate waiting to consume them both.

"Hakbin... I'll always be by your side. I won't let you be lonely. I'll be your mother, your sister, your friend... I'll do whatever you want. I promise."

What kept her from the suffocating cycle of guilt was the hope that she could distance herself from Hakbin once she became an adult. She thought she would be able to break free from him and find her own life... 

"I think you're not coming to your senses." 

"..." 

"But now you know, right? Who is important to you?" 

"..." 

"Keep doing this from now on. I'm the one you need to save. You must always look only at me so I don't go wrong."

“Let’s stop. Us.”

Those were the words my lover said to me as I lay there catching my breath after sex. Even if a sudden downpour had fallen from a clear sky, I think I would have been less shaken than I was in that moment.

“Why? What brought this on all of a sudden?”  
“Sex with you isn’t fun.”

This is already the third time I’ve been dumped for such an absurd, bewildering reason. I’ve gone past emptiness and sadness and started wondering if there really is something wrong with me.

“Hey, Seohyun. What does it… actually mean… to be good at it?”  
“Excuse me? Good at what?”  
“…Sex. I was thinking of trying to practice on my own, at least.”

It was something I blurted out while drunk, half out of spite. I felt wronged, but I was also genuinely curious. Just how amazing is the sex everyone else is having?

“I can help you.”  
“Huh?”

But something feels off. As Seohyun quietly listens to my worries, his eyes seem filled with heat. Is that just because I’ve had too much to drink?

“I said I’ll help you. With that practice.”

In a world where gods and humans coexist, there is a land called Rawon (羅園). The gods here survive by feeding on the reverence of humans, and in return use that power to protect them. Humans, meanwhile, live their lives under the gods’ grace, bound together in a “cycle of reverence and blessing.”

Yusa, the river god of Cheongyugang, has refused human reverence for nearly a century after losing his beloved human disciple, Tan’eo. Whenever he comes close to losing his divinity and fading into a lesser creature, he barely prolongs his fragile existence by borrowing divine power through “hapshin,” a union with the mountain god Gaho, who secretly harbors feelings for him.

Meanwhile, Dajin, the son of a great general whose entire clan was slaughtered by an evil god, longs to become an “Inje” — a human emperor chosen by the gods — for the sole purpose of revenge. Confident in his exceptional martial skill, he asks to become Gaho’s disciple, but Gaho sees through the vengeance consuming his heart and rejects him. Driven into despair by the belief that the gods abandoned both his parents and himself, Dajin ultimately throws himself into the Cheongyu River.

Wishing that no more humans connected to him would die, Yusa saves Dajin by passing on the last of his remaining divinity through a kiss, exhausting his own strength in the process. When Dajin awakens, he dismisses Yusa’s actions as mere whimsy and lashes out in anger. Demanding that Yusa take the divine power back, he impulsively kisses him in return.

In that fleeting moment of contact, the two share each other’s wounds and true feelings, unintentionally forming a master-disciple contract. Through “hapshin,” the act of exchanging divine power, Yusa gains the vitality needed to survive, while Dajin obtains the strength he needs for revenge.

A god unable to escape the scars of the past, and a human willing to risk his life for vengeance. As Rawon’s greatest competition, the Jeseonje (帝選祭), approaches for the first time in a hundred years, their desperate yet sensual tale of salvation begins.

[Time Slot 1 Load…]

display_title: I Stole the Trash Crown Prince's First Night
description:
I, Robellyn Dines, was reincarnated into the world of a satisfying revenge novel.

The problem was that I’d become the villainess doomed to be destroyed by that very revenge.

After having an affair with the Crown Prince, who was supposed to be the female lead’s husband, and committing countless evil deeds, her fate in the original story was to die beneath the guillotine.

But there’s no way I’m going to live like that.

“Fine. I’ll get rid of that useless excuse for a husband before anything even starts!”

All I had to do was push the original female lead and male lead together and escape this cursed storyline for good.

And I succeeded.

I even managed to prevent the moment that originally caused the female lead and Crown Prince Ian to fall in love.

But…

‘Why the hell is this man sleeping next to me?’

By accident, I ended up spending the night with the Crown Prince himself.

At this rate, things are no different from the original story! 

Panicking, I fled the scene immediately. After all, Ian was infamous for being a playboy. I’m sure he’ll forget a one-night mistake soon enough.

—

“You’re the one. The woman who slept with me and ran away.”

The moment I noticed Ian’s hand blocking the door, I realized something had gone terribly wrong.

“N- no, I think you’ve mistaken me for someone else—”

“Really?”

At my desperate denial, Ian only curled his lips into a dangerous smile. With slow, unhurried movements, he began undoing the buttons of his shirt one by one.

“Then shall we confirm it?”

“C- confirm what exactly?”

“Whether or not you’re the woman from that night. If we reenact it, you’ll remember soon enough.”

With those words, the final button of his shirt came undone.

In a small storehouse next to a mill lives Siru, a mature yet innocent young woman, and her young, sickly little brother, Siu.

One day, Siu's illness worsens. To save her brother's life, Siru ventures deep into the rugged mountains to find "Hogicho"—a medicinal herb said to make even a dead tiger spring back to life.
